newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Tass - Chubais to be Russian Finance Minister.
newsitem.headline: Tass - Chubais to be Russian Finance Minister.

text.p: Reformist Anatoly Chubais will be Finance Minister as well as First Deputy Prime Minister in the new Russian cabinet, Itar-Tass news agency said on Monday, quoting Finance Ministry sources.

Earlier the Kremlin said President Boris Yeltsin would announce later on Monday the membership and structure of the new cabinet, which has been the subject of tough bargaining between Chubais and Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin.
Chubais will be in overall charge of economic reforms.

Boris Nemtsov, the liberal governor of Nizhny Novgorod region who accepted Yeltsin's offer to serve as the other first deputy premier, is expected to take charge of natural monopolies, the social sector and relations with regional authorities.

In a separate report, Tass said two of the new deputy prime ministers -- a lower rank than Chubais and Nemtsov -- would be Vladimir Bulgak, now communications minister, and Oleg Sysuyev, presently mayor of the central industrial city of Samara.
The government press office said Chernomyrdin would make an announcement at 6 p.m. (1500 GMT), expected to centre on the new composition of the government.
